manifestNotes.linkedTestsPolicy: linkedTests is intentionally EMPTY for every scenario. This packet was authored under Gate G073 (Source Code Edit Lockout); no test file exists yet. Populating linkedTests with paths that do not exist would be fabrication and would also fail traceability-guard.sh's linked-test file-existence check. The planned test identifiers and their target suites are carried in plannedTests and are specified in full in scopes.md. The fixer populates linkedTests as each test is authored.
manifestNotes.idPatternNote: Scenario ids use the operator-mandated stable form SCN-BUG-019-003-NNN so that a single identifier is traceable across spec.md, scopes.md, report.md, and this manifest. This form carries more hyphen-separated segments than the canonical scenario-manifest.schema.json id pattern ^SCN-[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$. The divergence is recorded here rather than silently introduced; it matches the sibling convention already in use at specs/019-connector-wiring/bugs/BUG-019-002-scn-019-004-005-fidelity-gap/scenario-manifest.json.

scenarios.title: Connector-supplied source_ref is persisted for every connector

gherkin.given: an ephemeral test database with an empty artifacts table, and a connector produces a RawArtifact whose SourceRef is a non-empty stable external identifier carrying a URL distinct from that SourceRef
gherkin.when: PublishRawArtifact ingests the artifact through the shared front door at internal/pipeline/ingest.go
gherkin.then: the persisted artifacts row has source_ref equal to the connector-supplied SourceRef, source_url equal to the connector-supplied URL, and the two columns are not conflated in either direction

scenarios.title: An absent source_ref persists as SQL NULL rather than empty string

gherkin.given: an ephemeral test database with an empty artifacts table, and a connector produces a RawArtifact whose SourceRef is the empty string
gherkin.then: the persisted artifacts row has source_ref IS NULL and does not have source_ref equal to the empty string, preserving the distinction between no identifier and an empty identifier

scenarios.title: Re-ingesting the same external entity with changed content deduplicates by source_ref

gherkin.given: an artifact has already been ingested with source_id 'bookmarks' and source_ref 'https://example.test/a', and the upstream item's title and body have since changed so its content_hash differs from the stored row
gherkin.when: PublishRawArtifact ingests the changed item with the same source_id and the same source_ref
gherkin.then: the dedup probe matches the existing row by source_ref scoped to source_id, no second artifacts row exists for that source_id and source_ref pair, and the dedup decision does not depend on content_hash equality

scenarios.adversarialNote: This is the load-bearing adversarial scenario. The fixture MUST use two artifacts sharing source_id and source_ref but carrying DIFFERENT content_hash values, so the pre-existing ON CONFLICT (content_hash) clause cannot mask a missing source_ref path. A fixture using byte-identical artifacts is tautological and is explicitly disallowed.

scenarios.title: Identical source_ref values from different connectors are not falsely deduplicated

gherkin.given: an artifact has already been ingested with source_id 'discord' and source_ref '12345', and a different connector produces a RawArtifact with source_id 'youtube' and the identical source_ref '12345', the two carrying different content and therefore different content_hash values
gherkin.then: both artifacts rows are retained and the discord row is neither overwritten nor suppressed by the youtube row

scenarios.adversarialNote: Inverse adversarial guard. This scenario fails if a fixer corrects the probe column without adding source_id scoping, which would introduce a new cross-connector false-positive dedup defect strictly worse than the bug being fixed.

scenarios.title: GuestHost booking context resolves by the identifier its API contract advertises

gherkin.given: the GuestHost connector has ingested a booking artifact through the shared front door and the D3 identity-semantics decision has been resolved and implemented
gherkin.when: a caller requests booking context using the identifier the API contract advertises
gherkin.then: the booking artifact is found rather than returning a no-rows error, and the returned context carries the booking's guest, property, and stay-date fields

scenarios.unblockedNote: Previously gated on the D3 GuestHost booking identity-semantics decision. That decision was made by this packet as Option 4 (source_ref = event.EntityID for booking event types, event.ID retained in metadata, coupled to Re-ingestion Option B) and RATIFIED on 2026-07-29 via TR-BUG-019-003-001. Ratifier: owner-delegated ratification 2026-07-29; criterion: best long-term option, no shortcuts; recorded by bubbles.bug on behalf of the operator. This scenario is therefore no longer decision-blocked. Like all eight scenarios in this planning packet it remains unexecuted (linkedTests is empty) until a bugfix-fastlane delivery run implements Scope 4.

scenarios.title: Bookmark re-sync is idempotent when the bookmark title changes

gherkin.given: the bookmarks connector has already ingested a bookmark whose normalized URL is stored as its source_ref, and the same bookmark is re-exported upstream with a changed title so its content_hash differs
gherkin.when: the bookmarks connector runs a second sync containing that bookmark
gherkin.then: the batch dedup query recognises the normalized URL as already known, the bookmark is filtered out of the new-only result set, and exactly one artifacts row exists for that normalized URL

scenarios.title: Pre-existing NULL source_ref rows are backfilled where reconstructable and counted where not

gherkin.given: the artifacts table contains rows ingested before the fix whose source_ref is NULL, some belonging to connectors whose source_ref is deterministically reconstructable from persisted columns and others belonging to connectors whose source_ref is not reconstructable from any persisted column
gherkin.then: the reconstructable rows have source_ref populated with the reconstructed identifier, the non-reconstructable rows retain source_ref IS NULL rather than receiving a fabricated value, and the count of remaining non-reconstructable rows is reported so the residual is measurable

scenarios.title: The composite source index becomes a live access path

gherkin.given: source_ref is persisted for connector artifacts
gherkin.when: a dedup or consumer lookup filters artifacts by source_id together with source_ref
gherkin.then: the query is served by the idx_artifacts_source composite index and the index's second key column is no longer universally NULL for connector traffic
